asset: Hokkaido woodcarved bear biting salmon v20 shape-first, first genuine Harness GLB (before sole-height correction)
reviewer: ChatGPT visual inspection of all four actual Blender Cycles renders from official 3DCodeVerse Harness GLB, not illustration

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Heavy shoulders and compact body silhouette exist, but vertical shoulder transition and column-shaped lower legs remain.

face_and_expression.reason: Large pig-like round nose, dangling eyebrow/cheek curves and attached-looking ears undermine recognizable carved bear anatomy.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Salmon still reads as a broad flat plank in front of the snout; upper/lower bite contact not legible in front or 3/4.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Uniform rounded stamped ripples over shoulders and back resemble soft clay, not directional irregular chisel marks.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Toe pads are genuinely fused and less mechanical than v19, but three round toe lobes and vertical boots still appear; first run toes also penetrate floor.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Actual four-angle source GLB preview is sharp, genuine, and traceable to build run.

defects.finding: The nose visually rests on a separate flat salmon beam; lower jaw is visible only as dark shelf underneath.
defects.required_fix: Move to a single anatomical muzzle/jaw envelope and reshape fish shoulder; validate visible upper and lower contact from front and 3/4.

defects.finding: Large smooth oval nose and floating eyebrow-like curves; ears protrude as spheres.
defects.required_fix: Rebuild a small triangular bear nose and remove decorative detached eye/cheek lines; move ears deeper into skull and sculpt actual recesses.

defects.finding: Repeated rounded stamped skin texture on torso looks waxy.
defects.required_fix: Replace tiled dimple displacement by directional nonuniform recessed cuts tied to anatomy.

defects.finding: Fish snout is tapering too sharply, gill plate and fins read as separate geometric accessories.
defects.required_fix: Broaden fish head silhouette, reshape fins and integrate gill geometry.

defects.finding: First run three-toe pads exceed intended sole plane by approximately 0.024 world Z units.
defects.required_fix: Already patched in follow-up source commit ceea061f8f86cb6a5ecc4a43cee22641641181cd; check fresh render.

improvement_tasks: v20 first GLB technically built and rendered; artistic pass is still REJECTED.

Next shape iteration must address the actual sculptural bite and fish profile, not materials-only changes.
